4.script: Behind the famous monuments is a country of crowded streets, enormous cities, villages, farmers, fishermen, students, families, workers, street food, traffic, beaches, mosques, markets, and millions of people simply trying to build a better life. So what does everyday life actually look like in Egypt? How can people live in a country where the desert dominates the landscape? Why does everyone seem to depend on the same narrow river valley? And what happens when one of the world's oldest civilizations collides with one of the fastest-changing societies in Africa and the Middle East?
